select u.id as u_id, u.avatarUrl as u_avatarUrl, u.nickname as u_nickname, b.id as b_id, b.name as b_name, b.bizType as b_bizType, a.id, a.boardId, a.userId, a.title, substring(a.content, 1, 600) as content, a.visitCount, a.replyCount, a.likeCount, a.topState, a.essenceState, a.state, a.createTime, a.updateTime, a.bizType, a.extJson
order by a.topState desc,
(a.replyCount * 3 + a.likeCount * 2 + a.visitCount) desc a.createTime desc
limit #{offset,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER}

select u.id as u_id, u.avatarUrl as u_avatarUrl, u.nickname as u_nickname, u.gender as u_gender, u.isAdmin as u_isAdmin, u.state as u_state, u.deleteState as u_deleteState, b.id as b_id, b.name as b_name, b.bizType as b_bizType, b.state as b_state, b.deleteState as b_deleteState, a.id, a.boardId, a.userId, a.title, a.content, a.visitCount, a.replyCount, a.likeCount, a.topState, a.essenceState, a.state, a.createTime, a.updateTime, a.bizType, a.extJson from t_article a, t_user u, t_board b where a.userId = u.id and a.boardId = b.id and a.deleteState = 0 and a.id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT}

select b.id as b_id, b.name as b_name, b.bizType as b_bizType, a.id, a.boardId, a.userId, a.title, a.visitCount, a.replyCount, a.likeCount, a.topState, a.essenceState, a.state, a.createTime, a.updateTime, a.bizType, a.extJson from t_article a, t_board b where a.boardId = b.id and a.deleteState = 0 and a.userId = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.state = 0 and b.deleteState = 0 order by a.createTime desc

select count(1) from t_article a left join t_user u on a.userId = u.id left join t_board b on a.boardId = b.id
and ( a.title like concat('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') or u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') or u.username like concat('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') or b.name like concat('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') )
